transcribe_audio.accepted: File path, encoded audio bytes, binary stream, or a waveform (torch.Tensor or NumPy array) with sampling_rate.
transcribe_audio.waveform_shape: [samples] or [channels, samples]; at most 32 channels, averaged to mono.

file_decoding.paper_preset: torchaudio ffmpeg backend, channel mean, torchaudio.functional.resample.

input_values.window_padding: Every waveform is right padded with zeros to the 300 second window. The encoder attends to the complete window, including the padding.
input_values.attention_mask: Optional [batch, samples] of zeros and ones, valid samples first. Masked samples are set to zero; the mask does not shorten the encoder input.

transcribe.container: dict; with output_dir the same content is also written as files.
transcribe.abc: ABC score text, or null with abc_error when the score cannot be built.
transcribe.midi: bytes of the combined transcription; midis holds the separate parts.
transcribe.events: List of stitched timed events (see event).
transcribe.labs: Annotation text by name: chord, key, structure, melody_full, melody_vocal, melody_instrumental, rhythm_events, beat, downbeat.
transcribe.windows: Per-window start, end, accept_start, accept_end, prefix_end, generation_stop, prefix_tokens, token count, event counts.
transcribe.warnings: List of strings; empty when nothing was reported.
transcribe.tensors: Only with export_logits, export_scores, export_embeddings or output_hidden_states; CPU tensors grouped by window, or safetensors files with output_dir.

event.time: Absolute seconds, from the window's timestamp anchors.
event.values.timestamp: Absolute seconds; present on anchor events.
event.values.rhythm: eighth_position, plus meter (numerator, denominator) when the meter is stated. A beat sits at eighth_position * denominator / 8, which must be an integer below the numerator; position 0 is the downbeat.
event.values.key: Tonic:major or Tonic:minor in the canonical spelling of normalize_key_name.
event.values.chord: Raw model label with sharp-side roots, for example A#:min. Key-aware spelling is applied only to the chord LAB and ABC outputs.
event.values.melody: Notes with pitch (0-127), track (0 vocal, 1 instrumental), duration_bin, duration_steps and end_time in absolute seconds.

intervals.construction: For chord, key and structure: one row per labeled event, ending at the next labeled event or the audio duration; zero-length rows are dropped.
intervals.chord: correct_chord_rows respells each root using the key at the chord interval midpoint. Without a decoded key the spelling is kept.

decoder.completion: Generated EOS, or with the default preset a time token at or beyond the stop time, after which EOS is appended.
decoder.token_limit: Generation stops at 5120 tokens and EOS is appended. A warning is recorded only when the returned sequence is longer than 5120 tokens, so a sequence whose EOS is its 5120th token carries no warning.

audio_features.backbone_hidden_states: With output_hidden_states: 24 tensors [batch, frames, 1024], one per Conformer block of the LoRA-merged encoder, without the subsampling state.
audio_features.input_hidden_state: With output_hidden_states: the subsampling state [batch, frames, 1024].
audio_features.mixed_hidden_state: [batch, frames, 1024]; softmax-weighted sum of the subsampling state and the 24 block states.
audio_features.feature_attention_mask: [batch, frames] bool; true for ceil(valid_samples / 960) frames.

model.license: Weights CC BY-NC 4.0 (LICENSE); third-party terms in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

base_model.integrity: from_pretrained verifies these three digests before loading the parent.

architecture.encoder: MERT2 Conformer, 24 blocks, hidden size 1024, 16 heads, 360 second context.
architecture.lora: Rank 64, alpha 128 (scale 2.0) on query_proj, key_proj, value_proj and out_proj of every block.
architecture.layer_mixture: Softmax over 25 learned weights (subsampling state plus 24 blocks), then a 1024 to 512 projection.
architecture.decoder: BART decoder, 6 layers, d_model 512, 8 heads, FFN 2048, GELU, dropout 0.1, 5120 learned positions.
architecture.tied_weights: token_embedding, decoder.embed_tokens and output_projection share one matrix.

requirements.ffmpeg: 6.1 shared libraries; the ffmpeg executable for file input with the default preset.
requirements.observed_with_transformers_5.13.0: SheetSage2Model cannot be constructed or loaded: BartDecoder no longer accepts embed_tokens, _tied_weights_keys must be a mapping, tie_weights receives new keyword arguments, and the loader reports the tied keys as missing.

loading.sequence: Load this checkpoint in float32, verify and load the parent encoder, check the parent architecture, merge LoRA on CPU in float32, then apply the requested dtype and device.
loading.local_parent: base_model_path selects a local parent directory.
loading.result: eval mode, gradients disabled, config.weights_format becomes merged.

inference.decoding: Greedy argmax under PromptGrammarState with a key-value cache.
inference.precision: transcribe dtype bf16 (default): bfloat16 autocast on CUDA; fp32, or any non-CUDA device, runs in float32.

default_preset.generation_stop: 200 seconds into the window; for the last window min(duration - start, 300).
default_preset.long_prefix: A prefix of 4992 tokens or more raises ValueError.

paper_preset.long_prefix: A prefix of 5104 tokens or more is dropped with a warning.

windowing.last_window: Shifted back to end at the audio end.
windowing.accepted_region: Each window contributes events from the end of the previous accepted region up to window start + 300 - lookahead; the last window up to the audio end.
windowing.prefix: Later windows continue from a token prefix rebuilt from already accepted events between the window start and the accepted end.

batching.generate: constrained_prompt_generate_batch decodes a batch that shares one prefix and one stop time.
batching.audio_features: forward and get_audio_features accept a batch of waveforms.

adapter.model_class: SheetSage2Runtime in embedding/sheetsage2_runtime.py rebuilds the native module tree on the installed transformers and loads both checkpoints strictly. SheetSage2Model itself is not instantiated.
adapter.native_modules: tokenization_sheetsage2, generation_sheetsage2, exports_sheetsage2 and the modules they import, plus configuration_mert2 and modeling_mert2 from the MERT-v2 snapshot; all loaded from hash-verified copies.
adapter.audio: Shared TorchCodec decode, arithmetic-mean mono and torchaudio Resample to 24 kHz; no ffmpeg executable.
adapter.windowing: The default preset: 300 second windows, overlap 200, lookahead 100.
adapter.batching: Up to inference_batch_size windows of different tracks per step. generate_batch decodes rows with different prefixes by left padding with per-row positions.
adapter.completion: A window that reaches 5120 tokens without EOS or the stop time, or whose timestamp anchors are missing or run backward, fails the whole track.
adapter.intervals: exports_sheetsage2.interval_rows, normalize_key_name and correct_chord_rows in the native order; equal neighbouring labels are merged afterwards.
adapter.embedding: 24 layers of 1024 values: frame mean weighted by each frame's accepted real-audio time, then L2 normalization per layer. Layer 24 is the default.
adapter.stored: Timeline events, derived features and layer embeddings. ABC and MIDI are not stored; exports_sheetsage2.export_result builds them from the stitched events.
adapter.packages: Versions come from pyproject.toml and differ from the upstream requirements above.
